-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

list-messages.name: list-messages
list-messages.description: List email messages from inbox or a specific folder. Supports filtering by unread, importance, etc.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 10, max: 100)
params.folderId: Mail folder ID or well-known name (e.g., "Inbox", "SentItems", "Drafts", "DeletedItems", "Archive"). Defaults to Inbox.

get-message.name: get-message
get-message.description: Get full details of a specific email message by ID, including body and attachments.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to retrieve

send-message.name: send-message
send-message.description: Send an email message from the connected Outlook account.

params.subject: Email subject
params.body: Email body (plain text, Markdown, or HTML)
params.isHtml: Whether body is HTML (default: false, auto-detects Markdown)
params.importance: Message importance: low, normal, high (default: normal)
params.attachments: Array of file attachments to include

reply-message.name: reply-message
reply-message.description: Reply to an existing email message.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to reply to
params.replyAll: Whether to reply to all recipients (default: false)

forward-message.name: forward-message
forward-message.description: Forward an email message to other recipients.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to forward
params.comment: Optional comment to include with the forwarded message

search-messages.name: search-messages
search-messages.description: Search for email messages. Supports searching by subject, body, sender, etc.

params.query: Search query text (searches subject, body, sender, etc.)

modify-message.name: modify-message
modify-message.description: Modify a message: mark as read/unread, set importance, add categories, or flag it.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to modify
params.flag: Set flag status: notFlagged, flagged, complete

move-message.name: move-message
move-message.description: Move a message to a different mail folder.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to move
params.destinationFolderId: Destination folder ID or well-known name (e.g., "Inbox", "Archive", "DeletedItems", "JunkEmail")

delete-message.name: delete-message
delete-message.description: Delete a message (moves to Deleted Items) or permanently delete it.

params.messageId: The ID of the message to delete
params.permanent: If true, permanently deletes the message. Otherwise moves to Deleted Items (default: false)

list-drafts.name: list-drafts
list-drafts.description: List all draft emails in the account.

params.maxResults: Maximum number of drafts to return (default: 10, max: 100)

update-draft.name: update-draft
update-draft.description: Update an existing draft email by replacing its content.

params.draftId: The ID of the draft to update
params.subject: Email subject

params.draftId: The ID of the draft to send
The ID of the draft to delete

list-folders.name: list-folders
list-folders.description: List all mail folders in the account.

params.includeChildFolders: Whether to include child folders (default: false)

params.parentFolderId: Parent folder ID (optional, creates at top level if omitted)

delete-folder.name: delete-folder
delete-folder.description: Delete a mail folder and all its contents.

params.folderId: The ID of the folder to delete

get-attachment.name: get-attachment
get-attachment.description: Get the content of an email attachment by its attachment ID.

params.messageId: The ID of the message containing the attachment
params.attachmentId: The ID of the attachment to retrieve
params.saveToFile: If true, saves the attachment to /workspace/email-attachments/

store-attachment.name: store-attachment
store-attachment.description: Download and store an email attachment to the local filesystem.

params.messageId: The ID of the message containing the attachment
params.attachmentId: The ID of the attachment to store

list-rules.name: list-rules
list-rules.description: List all inbox rules (mail filters) for the account.

name: Outlook
description: Microsoft Outlook email management - send, read, search, and organize emails via Microsoft Graph API

changelog.notes: Initial release — send, read, search, reply to and organize Outlook emails, with drafts, folders and attachments
